smell: Detector candidate: submitted form field values and CRM property values are broad S.String values.

exception.reason: HubSpot form and CRM property payloads are third-party API pass-through strings. Empty string can be a meaningful submitted value or property clearing value, so NonEmptyString would break valid API payloads; field/property names are handled separately as actionable non-empty identifiers.
exception.boundary: HubSpot form field and CRM property value compatibility boundary
